item.title: Why I’ll always watch AFCON – Arsenal legend, Thierry Henry

item.title: Impeachment: Okai, Wali weigh Fubara’s survival chances
item.description: A chieftain of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, Austin Okai, has described the impeachment proceedings in Rivers State as an indication that the All Progressives Congress, ADC, has betrayed Governor Siminalayi Fubara. item.title: Benue boat mishap claims lives of six students as others remain missing
item.description: At least, six students have lost their lives on Monday after the boat they were travelling in capsized middle of Buruku River in Buruku Local Government Area of Benue State. The incident occurred at about 10:00 p.m. while the boat was midstream, ferrying passengers, many of whom were students returning to school alongside several vehicles. item.title: Kano cleric, Sheikh Ibrahim arraigned for alleged illegal land sales
item.description: The Kano State Police Command on Tuesday arraigned Islamic cleric, Sheikh Ibrahim Isa Makwarari, before Magistrate Court No. 53 in the Normansland area of Kano metropolis. Sheikh Makwarari is accused of involvement in the illegal sale of government and community-owned lands, an offence described by the police as a serious violation of land administration laws.
